name: RelayMind guidance
description: Optional per-prompt hint that names the few skills and tools a prompt needs (RM45), with an optional strict limit to them (RM46).

baseUrl.description: The gateway's loopback address, such as http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable with the application token. Default RELAYMIND_APP_TOKEN.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait before going on without a hint. Default 13000.

maxPicks.description: The most assets to name. Unset, the gateway's setting decides.

toolsFile.description: Optional absolute path to a JSON list of {name, description} tools to include in the offer.

limit.description: hint (default) leaves other skills loadable. strict refuses what was offered and not selected for this request.
